title: The Town Festival
description: Three short recordings about a festival in the town square.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Making plans
parts.intro: You will hear Mai and Jack talking about the town festival.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Jack, are you going to the town festival on Saturday?

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: Of course, Mai! It's in the main square, from ten o'clock until nine at night.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: There's a parade at eleven. My sister is playing the guitar.

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: Cool! I want to see the dancers. And I want to try the food. Last year the noodles were delicious.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I'll meet you by the fountain at half past ten. No, wait, my dad will bring me early. Let's meet at ten.

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: OK. I'll bring some money for ice cream. It will be a very busy day, so I think we should go early and stay late.

parts.title: Part 2 · A festival announcement
parts.intro: You will hear the festival organiser, Mr Cole, speaking to the crowd.

script.speaker: Mr Cole
script.text: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the town festival. I'm Mr Cole, the organiser.

script.speaker: Mr Cole
script.text: At twelve o'clock there is a dance show on the big stage. At one o'clock there's a cooking competition. The winner gets a golden spoon.

script.speaker: Mr Cole
script.text: For children, there's a face-painting tent next to the bank, and games for everyone near the fountain.

script.speaker: Mr Cole
script.text: Please keep the square clean and use the bins. If you lose something, go to the information desk by the church.

script.speaker: Mr Cole
script.text: The fireworks begin at nine o'clock. Enjoy the day! Thank you for coming, and please remember to look after your friends and family.

parts.title: Part 3 · A phone message
parts.intro: You will hear Jack leave a message for Mai.

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: Hi, Mai. It's Jack. I'm at the festival, but I can't find you!

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: I'm standing by the ice cream stall, the one with the blue umbrella. I've just seen your sister's parade. She was fantastic!

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: I took lots of photos on my phone. Also, I won a small teddy bear at the ring game. It's for you.

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: Please call me when you arrive. I'll wait here until twelve. Then we can walk around together and find some food. I'm really hungry!
